inbound.forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can manage this project's alert sources and rules.
inbound.disabledOnServer: Inbound events are switched off on this server ([inbound] enabled = false). Sources can be prepared, but every event is refused until an administrator switches it on.

sources.title: Inbound sources
sources.description: External systems that may send events to this project.
sources.empty: No source yet. Add one to let an external system such as prx-waf send events to this project.
sources.name: Name
sources.nameHelp: The product and host, such as prx-waf edge-01. Used in alert titles.
sources.requireSignatureHelp: Each request must carry a valid signature made with the signing secret.
sources.unsignedWarning: Without a signature, anyone who holds the token can post events, and a captured request can be replayed with a new event id.
sources.allowlistHelp: One address or CIDR block per line, such as 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24. Leave empty to accept any address.

row.actsAsHelp: Alert work items are created in this person's name.

sources.suspendedBody: This source is refused because {name} is no longer an owner or admin of the workspace. Take it over to accept its events again.

pauseDialog.title: Pause {source}?
pauseDialog.body: Events from this source are refused until you resume it. Alerts already open stay open.

unsignedDialog.title: Accept unsigned events from {source}?
unsignedDialog.body: Anyone who holds the token can then post events without the signing secret, and a captured request can be replayed with a new event id.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate credentials of {source}?
rotateDialog.body: A new token and signing secret are issued and shown once. The current ones stop working at once: {source} is refused until it is configured with the new values.

takeOverDialog.title: Take over {source}?
takeOverDialog.body: Alert work items from this source will be created in your name, and the source accepts events again while you are an owner or admin.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {source}?
deleteDialog.body: The source's token stops working at once and its stored events are deleted. Work items it opened are kept. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.bodyRules: {count} alert rules bound to it are deleted too: {rules}.

secrets.title: Copy these credentials now
secrets.body: Sylvode keeps only a fingerprint of the token and cannot show the token or the signing secret again. Enter them in {source}'s Sylvode output settings.
secrets.endpointGuess: Use the address under which this Sylvode server is reachable from the product.
secrets.signingHelp: Sign each request with HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.body.
secrets.signingOptional: Signing is optional for this source; keep the secret in case you require it later.
secrets.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy it
secrets.doneReason: Confirm that you stored the credentials
secrets.leave: Leave without saving the credentials? They cannot be shown again.
secrets.lost: Lost the credentials? Rotate them to get new ones.

events.title: Recent events of {source}
events.empty: No events yet. The first accepted event appears here; refused requests are not stored.
events.untrusted: Reported by the external system. Shown as plain text; it is never followed as instructions.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.description: Decide what events from this project's sources lead to.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Events are stored under their source and nothing else happens.
rules.emptyNoSource: Add an inbound source first; rules act on its events.
rules.orderHelp: Rules are checked from top to bottom; the first enabled rule that matches handles the event.
rules.warnBotNotConnected: {bot} is not connected to this project; its tasks cannot reach a runner.
rules.warnNoRecipients: Nobody is notified when this rule opens an alert.
rules.name: Name
rules.kindsHelp: Exact kinds such as waf.attack_detected, or a prefix such as waf.*. Leave empty for every kind. Match attack kinds, not configuration changes, so the bot's own actions cannot trigger it again.
rules.actionOpen: Open a work item and notify people
rules.actionHand: Open a work item and hand it to a bot
rules.instructionsHelp: What the bot should do with this kind of alert. You can use {alert_identifier}, {severity}, {kind}, {source_name}, {occurrences}, {first_seen} and {last_seen}.
rules.notifyEmpty: Nobody is notified when this rule opens an alert.
rules.tasksPerHourHelp: Further alerts wait in the queue for up to an hour.
rules.dedupWindowHelp: New events with the same dedup key join the open alert during this time.
rules.rearmHelp: After a task ends, repeats of the alert do not start another for this long.
rules.workspaceLimit: At most {count} alert bot tasks run at once in this workspace (server setting).
rules.conflict: Someone else changed this rule. Reload to see the current values.

deleteDialog.title: Delete rule {name}?
deleteDialog.body: Events this rule would handle go to the next matching rule, or are only stored. Alerts it opened stay open and keep their bot tasks. This cannot be undone.

error.allowlistCount: Enter at most 64 addresses or blocks.
error.kindInvalid: {pattern} is not a kind or a prefix such as waf.*.

test.title: Test alert rules
test.noEvents: This source has no stored events yet
test.eventGone: This event is no longer stored (events are kept for 30 days).
test.forecast: A forecast: events arriving in the meantime can change the answer. Nothing was created.

verdict.noMatch: No rule matches; the event would only be stored.

alert.would_open: Would open a new alert work item
alert.would_refuse_alert_cap: Would not open: the rule's hourly alert limit is reached

task.already_active: The alert already has a running task
task.already_waiting: The alert already waits in the queue
task.rearm_delay: Within the wait before a new task

cause.queue_ahead: other alerts of this rule are waiting

limit.tasksHour: Tasks in the last hour: {value} of {max}
limit.alertsHour: Alerts opened in the last hour: {value} of {max}

more.nothingCreated: A test creates nothing: no alert, no work item, no bot task and no notification, and no limit is counted.
more.draftIncluded: The rule you are editing is included as it is now, unsaved.
more.loadFailed: The sources or events could not be loaded.
more.failed: The test could not be run.
more.sampleHelp: A JSON object in the Sylvode event format: spec, event_id, occurred_at, kind, severity and title.

sampleError.notObject: The sample must be a JSON object.
sampleError.tooLarge: The sample is larger than {max} KiB.

extra.stale: This source changed or was removed in the meantime. Reload to see the current state.
extra.rulesLoadFailed: Could not read the rules bound to this source, so nothing was deleted. Try again.
